Name: Adino the Eznite
Summary: Adino the Eznite, the Tachmonite that sat in the seat, was chief among David's captains. He lifted his spear against eight hundred men at one time and slew them. Some modern renderings call him Josheb-basshebeth.
KeyStory: Adino slew eight hundred men in a single encounter.
LifeLesson: One man's spear, in God's hand, can stand where an army cannot.
